parameters.query:
SELECT e.full_name, e.title, e.department, e.employee_code,
       e.hire_date::text, m.full_name as manager_name
FROM employees e
LEFT JOIN employees m ON m.id = e.manager_id
WHERE e.id = '{{ $json.employee_id }}'::uuid

INSERT INTO tool_calls
  (workspace_id, employee_id, tool_name, input, output, status, error, latency_ms)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json._lws }}'::uuid,
  {{ $json._lemp ? "'" + $json._lemp + "'" : 'NULL' }}::uuid,
  '{{ $json._ltool }}',
  '{{ $json._lin }}'::jsonb,
  {{ $json._lout ? "'" + $json._lout + "'" : 'NULL' }}::jsonb,
  '{{ $json._lst }}',
  {{ $json._lerr ? "'" + $json._lerr + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json._llat }}::integer
)
RETURNING id
